b1-mohacs-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Weakened Kingdom
b1-mohacs-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks why Hungary was weak before the Battle of Mohács.
b1-mohacs-01.prompt: Name some reasons why Hungary was weak after King Matthias's death.
cues: Say what happened to the Black Army
Say what the treasury was like
Say what Dózsa György led in 1514
Give the result with a cause
b1-mohacs-01.target: Mátyás halála után a fekete sereget feloszlatták, és a kincstár üres lett. 1514-ben Dózsa György parasztfelkelést vezetett. A belső viszályok miatt az ország gyenge volt.
b1-mohacs-01.english: After Matthias's death the Black Army was disbanded, and the treasury became empty. In 1514 György Dózsa led a peasant revolt. Because of the internal strife the country was weak.
b1-mohacs-01.canDo: I can describe the domestic political and financial crisis in Hungary after King Matthias's death.

b1-mohacs-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Sultan Suleiman
b1-mohacs-02.scenario: In your Hungarian class, the teacher asks about Sultan Suleiman and the fortress of Nándorfehérvár.
b1-mohacs-02.prompt: Say when Suleiman became sultan and what happened to Nándorfehérvár.
cues: Say the year Suleiman became sultan
Say what he did after taking the throne
Say what happened to Nándorfehérvár in 1521
b1-mohacs-02.target: I. Szulejmán 1520-ban lett szultán. Miután trónra lépett, hadjáratot indított Magyarország ellen, és 1521-ben Nándorfehérvár elesett.
b1-mohacs-02.english: Suleiman I became sultan in 1520. After he took the throne, he launched a campaign against Hungary, and in 1521 Nándorfehérvár fell.
b1-mohacs-02.canDo: I can describe the rise of Sultan Suleiman I and his military offensive against Hungary.

b1-mohacs-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Battle of Mohács
b1-mohacs-03.scenario: At the Mohács memorial site, a visitor asks you what happened in the battle.
b1-mohacs-03.prompt: Tell the visitor when the battle was, how many men fought, how long it lasted and what happened to Tomori Pál.
cues: Say the date of the battle
Say how long it lasted and what happened to Tomori
b1-mohacs-03.target: Mohácsnál 1526. augusztus 29-én mintegy 25 ezer magyar harcolt legalább 60 ezer török ellen. A csata alig két óra alatt véget ért, és Tomori Pál elesett.
b1-mohacs-03.english: At Mohács on 29 August 1526 about 25,000 Hungarians fought against at least 60,000 Turks. The battle ended in barely two hours, and Pál Tomori was killed.
b1-mohacs-03.canDo: I can recount the course of the Battle of Mohács on August 29, 1526.

b1-mohacs-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Death of King Louis II
b1-mohacs-04.scenario: At the Mohács memorial site, a visitor asks you how King Louis II died and what followed.
b1-mohacs-04.prompt: Say how old the king was, how he died and what happened because he had no child.
cues: Say how old the king was
Say what happened because he had no child
b1-mohacs-04.target: A húszéves II. Lajos menekülés közben a Csele-patakba fulladt. Nem volt gyermeke, ezért két királyt választottak.
b1-mohacs-04.english: The twenty-year-old Louis II drowned in the Csele brook while fleeing. He had no child, so two kings were elected.
b1-mohacs-04.canDo: I can narrate the tragedy of King Louis II in the swollen Csele brook.

b1-mohacs-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Famous Saying
b1-mohacs-05.scenario: In a café in Pécs, your Hungarian friend laughs about a small mistake and says «Több is veszett Mohácsnál». She asks if you know what it means.
b1-mohacs-05.prompt: Explain when Hungarians say it and what it means.
cues: Say when Hungarians use the saying
b1-mohacs-05.target: Ha kisebb baj történik, a magyarok azt mondják: „Több is veszett Mohácsnál.” Ez azt jelenti, hogy volt már nagyobb csapás is.
b1-mohacs-05.english: When a small trouble happens, Hungarians say: "More was lost at Mohács." This means that there has been a bigger blow before.
b1-mohacs-05.canDo: I can explain the cultural meaning and usage of 'Több is veszett Mohácsnál'.

b1-mohacs-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Mohács in Three Sentences
b1-mohacs-consolidation.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you to summarise the causes, the events and the results of Mohács.
b1-mohacs-consolidation.prompt: Summarise Mohács in a few sentences: the cause, the battle and the result.
cues: Give a cause of the weakness
Say what happened to the army and the king
Say what happened to the country afterwards
b1-mohacs-consolidation.target: A belső viszályok miatt az ország gyenge volt. 1526-ban Mohácsnál Lajos király serege vereséget szenvedett, és a király a Csele-patakba fulladt. Utána az ország három részre szakadt.
b1-mohacs-consolidation.english: Because of the internal strife the country was weak. In 1526 at Mohács the army of King Louis was defeated, and the king drowned in the Csele brook. Afterwards the country split into three parts.
b1-mohacs-consolidation.canDo: I can summarize the causes, events, and consequences of the Battle of Mohács (1526).
